_study: G1 cross-example transduction of the donor-side delivered state
_run: house 4-lens adversarial design red-team on the concrete design + H_dev pilot, before confirmatory freeze (2026-07-23)

overall.generic_axis_scope_note: The non-overclaim WORDING ("example-specific transduction NOT ESTABLISHED", not "absent") is the correct register and must be kept — but as the pilot stands the GENERIC_READOUT_AXIS verdict is BOTH under-identified and over-scoped, so the scope is NOT yet defensible and cannot be frozen as-is. (1) Under-identified: the Delta_spec = -0.34 is substantially a norm-wastage DENOISING ARTIFACT, not evidence the example-specific content is uninformative. Norm-matching a single high-variance source vector against its low-variance population mean forces REAL to spend its off-axis (sin^2) energy on a locally-1D margin readout; tau(REAL)/tau(MEAN)=0.644/0.979=0.66 lands almost exactly on E[cos(s_j,s_bar)] (mean 0.43 / median 0.50), the geometric prediction of pure wastage. The energy spectrum (top-1 0.46, ~54% off-axis) REFUTES the opposite collinear-by-construction artifact, proving a large example-specific component EXISTS — which only sharpens the gap: at alpha=1 the design cannot tell "off-axis content is uninformative noise" (true GENERIC) from "off-axis content is informative but the donor-margin readout is blind to it" (transduction survives), which is exactly the INTENT question. (2) Over-scoped: G1 injects ONLY the C16/C26 final donor residual; it never touches L3H1's attention address (C23), L3H1->U_info routing (C17), or the transporter heads (C18). Under the project's own frozen ADDRESS/PAYLOAD split, a generic delivered CONTENT is fully compatible with an example-specific ADDRESS (C34/C35). RULING ON THE PERP ARM: the parallel/perpendicular decomposition (inject s_j-perp alone at native norm, low-alpha to avoid margin_hard saturation, with its own M8 OOD gate; s_j-perp carries ~54% of energy so is well-powered) is a MUST-ADD before freeze, not nice-to-have — it is the cheap head-only arm that cleanly disambiguates the denoising artifact from genuine off-axis transduction, and the code already implements it as --decomp (must be run on H_dev, sealed, and made to gate the GENERIC interpretation). With (a) the perp arm run and (b) the null re-scoped to "C16/C26 delivered final-residual state, via additive alpha=1 injection through the short-source rank-8 U_D" (exempting C17/C18/C23, carrying an R24-style within-intervention qualifier), the GENERIC scope becomes defensible.
must_fix_before_freeze: IDENTIFIABILITY CRUX (Lens1-F1, MAJOR): Run the parallel/perpendicular arm before freeze. Wire --decomp onto H_dev, inject s_j-perp alone at native norm in the low-alpha linear regime with its own M8 OOD gate, and make the GENERIC interpretation conditional on s_j-perp being sub-SESOI. s_j-perp restoring => transduction survives despite Delta_spec<0; s_j-perp inert => clean GENERIC. Also report tau(REAL)/tau(MEAN) against E[cos] as the denoising-null prediction.

DECISION-RULE RECONCILIATION (Lens1-F2, MAJOR): Reconcile code vs prereg. _verdict routes GENERIC on dspec_not_pos=(upper CI <= SESOI), strictly broader than prereg S6's equivalence-null (CI within +/-SESOI). Either restrict GENERIC to a genuine equivalence-null and add a distinct label for 'REAL significantly below MEAN (denoising-consistent)', or keep the broader condition but STOP treating |Delta_spec| as an effect size (effect_resolvable=TRUE certifies the wrong quantity) and require the write-up to attribute negative Delta_spec to geometry.

R22 STABILITY VACUOUS (Lens2-F1, MAJOR): n_src=300==|src_all|=300, so permutation[:300] reshuffles the same objects; U_D and s_bar are byte-identical every draw and Delta_spec_sd collapses to ~0 => stability_ok passes trivially, reproducing the exact A9/C30 R22 blind spot. Set n_src strictly below |src_all| (e.g. 200) or resample sources WITH REPLACEMENT per draw so each derives an independent U_D/s_bar, and raise draw count above 5.

SCOPE THE NULL TO C16/C26 (Lens3-F1+F3, MAJOR+MINOR/R24): Fix the S6 decision table and S11-#10 CLAIMS wording so the null bounds ONLY the C16/C26 delivered final-residual state; explicitly EXEMPT C17 (routing), C18 (transporters), C23 (address+payload joint). Add the same locus/method qualifier to the GENERIC and NO_TRANSDUCTION rows: the null is specific to final-residual additive injection through the short-source rank-8 U_D and does not bound addressing or earlier-layer/non-additive example-specificity.

M8 OOD BAND (Lens4-F1, MAJOR): Implement the prereg's designated only-failable health check. Compute ||H_co,i+alpha*s||/||H_cl,i|| and donor-logit entropy per interpreted arm x dose, seal the band on H_dev, and gate/flag breaches. Until then alpha=1.5 (and arguably 1.0) rows are uncontrolled for off-manifold injection given known margin_hard saturation. T['Hcl'] is already captured so the data exists.

M4/M9 UN-FAILABLE MEMORIALS (Lens4-F2+F6, MAJOR+MINOR, R21 class): M4_no_leakage and M9_determinism are hardcoded True. Compute M4 from actual gene sets (assert src gene-ids disjoint from H_dev U H_conf, hash both into provenance, fail otherwise); compute M9 from a cross-seed cohort-identity hash. Delete or re-label the dead POS_SHAM!=0 stopping condition.

M3 TOOTHLESS GATE (Lens4-F3, MAJOR): The strongest memorial (SELF reproduces C26's +0.875) is gated only at self_suff>0.3 and the confirmatory _verdict never checks SELF. Seal the C26-reproduction tolerance on D_src/H_dev (e.g. |SELF-0.875|<0.05) and gate BOTH smoke and confirmatory verdict on it.

SRC_SHAM ROLE (Lens2-F2 + Lens4-F5, MAJOR+MINOR): SRC_SHAM absolute-tau HW=0.176 > SESOI_TAU=0.10 cannot pass the preregistered TOST equivalence family, so a positive verdict would be unlicensed by S6's own rule. Either repower SRC_SHAM (more sources) if a positive verdict is in play, or narrow its written role to the surviving sham-frac ratio-exclusion (upper CI ~0.28 < 0.5) and drop the equivalence-family claim. Also aggregate/report frac(sham_ok) and EXCLUDE (not zero-fill) no-decoy fallback pairs, which currently bias SRC_SHAM toward the equivalence null.

SEAL SESOI_spec (Lens2-F4, MINOR but a prereg S11-#3 freeze prerequisite): SESOI_spec=0.05 is the code default, never sealed from the H_dev pilot and scale-conflated with the 0.05 absolute-nat house floor. Seal and justify it on H_dev and document its scale relation before freeze (current -0.34 is 6x so it does not bite, but the threshold must be frozen).
can_defer_or_report: Lens2-F5 + Lens3-F2 (per-context / G1-E): the 6-context secondary max-T family is not implemented; do NOT report ANY per-context Delta_spec until (a) the max-T family adjustment is coded and (b) SELF-and-U_D-energy-captured is reported per Atlas context and gates per-context interpretation (short-source U_D can misfit long-intron/non-canonical contexts, turning an instrument limit into a false GENERIC). Pooled primary is unaffected, so the per-context family may be deferred entirely.

Lens3-F4 (MINOR): pre-declare a min_effect-qualified sensitivity Delta_spec (targets with coup>=0.20; ~65% currently fall below) to confirm GENERIC survives on behaviourally-competent targets and is not entangled with inert-target denoising dilution. Recommended, not blocking (ratio-of-means mitigates).

Lens1-F3 (MINOR): report SELF's ||s|| (0.554) beside REAL/MEAN (0.678) and label SELF as the un-norm-matched M3 validity anchor; do NOT read MEAN>SELF as pathology or as denoising corroboration in either direction.

Lens2-F3 (MINOR): report per-context bootstrap denominator health (fraction of replicates with weighted d below ~0.25x observed) and use studentized/BCa for per-context tau; pooled E[coup]=0.41 keeps the primary safe.

Lens4-F4 (MINOR): additionally run the permuted-label FPR once on the actual cross-gene match_pairs structure (currently calibrated only on degenerate gt==gs self-pairs, which collapse the two-way dyadic bootstrap to one-way), or state the two-way FPR is inherited-from-B3 and untested here. Cheap; recommended before freeze.
Lens4-F6 residual (MINOR): mechanize M6 (RANDOM tau<=0.05) and per-context M7 (E[coup]>=0.20) as hard asserts in _verdict rather than relying on the pilot happening to satisfy them.

Lens4-F7 (MINOR): add a planted-positive pass through the full _verdict() so the decision-layer thresholds are calibrated (a known-beta source should return TRANSDUCING); and either restore the prereg S4 'planted slope CI covers 1' criterion or log a pre-run amendment justifying slope>0 by saturation+U_D-projection.

Lens4-F8 (MINOR): document the single admitted GC donor (harmless — readout masks dwin and GC donors also carry G there); add a minimum donor-partner separation guard for targets (e.g. >=10 nt) or report the realized distance distribution so near-donor CC corruptions can be excluded.
overall.bottom_line: AUTHORIZE THE FREEZE ONLY AFTER THE MUST-FIX LIST LANDS — do not freeze the confirmatory as it stands. All four lenses independently return FIXABLE_THEN_RUNNABLE with survivor=true; there is NO un-fixable FATAL, and every defect has a stated, mechanical, mostly head-only-compute fix. The pooled inference machinery is sound (sum/sum ratio-of-means is the correct robust form for the heavy-tailed denominator, pooled E[coup]=0.41 is safely off zero, the two-way product-Poisson dyadic bootstrap is valid-if-conservative, the primary Delta_spec is multiplicity-protected, R23 compliance is clean, and R22 payload-semantics discipline is honored). But two things block a defensible frozen verdict TODAY: (1) the headline Delta_spec=-0.34 is substantially a norm-wastage DENOISING ARTIFACT, so the GENERIC_READOUT_AXIS reading is under-identified until the parallel/perpendicular arm (already coded as --decomp) is run on H_dev with its own OOD gate and made to gate the interpretation — this is the single most important pre-freeze action and it is cheap; and (2) the freeze plumbing is not trustworthy — the R22 stability certification is vacuous (n_src==|src_all|), the designated failable health check M8 is unimplemented, and M4/M9 are hardcoded True (R21-class un-failable memorials) while the strongest memorial M3 is gated at a toothless 0.3. Also narrow the null's scope to the C16/C26 final-residual delivered state (it does NOT bound the C17/C18/C23 address/routing it never intervened on) and carry an R24-style within-intervention qualifier. None of these are identifiability-fatal; the large structurally-driven primary effect is expected to survive them. Fix the nine must-fix items (chiefly: run the perp arm, un-hardcode M4/M8/M9/M3, repair the R22 draws, reconcile the GENERIC decision rule to the prereg, and re-scope the claim), re-run the pilot gate, THEN freeze.

lenses.lens: Identifiability — does Δ_spec = τ(REAL) − τ(MEAN) identify example-specific transduction vs a gene-generic readout axis?

findings.title: Δ_spec sign/magnitude is forced by norm-wastage geometry, not evidence the example-specific content is uninformative
findings.scenario: Write each source state in U_D as s_j = μ + ε_j, with μ ≈ the readout axis s̄ (C16/C26 make s̄ the productive direction) and ε_j the example-specific part largely orthogonal to μ. Both arms are norm-matched to ||s_j|| (M5). MEAN puts the whole norm on μ̂; REAL squanders the sin² fraction on ε_j, which does not move a locally-1D scalar readout. In the linear regime this predicts τ(REAL)/τ(MEAN) ≈ E[cos(s_j,s̄)]. Observed 0.644/0.979 = 0.66 sits right on the measured cos (mean 0.43, median 0.50). So Δ_spec = −0.34 is exactly what a PURE denoising artifact yields even if ε_j is genuine, informative example-specific content that the donor-margin readout at α=1 simply cannot express. The design cannot separate 'ε_j is uninformative noise' (true generic axis) from 'ε_j is informative but off the readout axis' — which is precisely the discrimination §0/INTENT demands. Note the energy spectrum (top-1 0.46, top-8 0.73) and cos median 0.50 REFUTE the 'collinear-by-construction' artifact (the example-specific component is real and ~54% of the energy) but that sharpens rather than resolves this: we now know a large off-axis component exists whose (non-)restoration is the whole question, and Δ_spec alone leaves it ambiguous. A skeptic kills the GENERIC_READOUT_AXIS reading as under-identified.
findings.fix: REQUIRED before freeze (head-only compute, same cohort): add a parallel/perpendicular arm. Decompose s_j = s_j∥ (along ŝ̄) + s_j⊥ (orthogonal, within U_D); inject s_j⊥ ALONE at its native norm vs a norm-matched random-perpendicular control, in the low-α linear regime to avoid margin_hard saturation (P3.3), with its own M8 OOD/norm gate. s_j⊥ is well-powered (carries ~54% of energy). s_j⊥ sub-SESOI ⇒ clean GENERIC (off-axis example content genuinely non-restoring); s_j⊥ restoring ⇒ example-specific transduction survives despite Δ_spec<0. Also report τ(REAL)/τ(MEAN) against E[cos(s_j,s̄)] as the denoising-null prediction; the observed 0.66 > ~0.50 hints the off-axis part is NOT fully inert, so the perp arm is load-bearing, not cosmetic.

findings.title: Strongly-negative Δ_spec is presented as a resolvable effect; prereg 'equivalence-null' does not match code 'not-positive'
findings.scenario: The MDE gate marks Δ_spec reaches_verdict via effect_resolvable = |−0.34| − 0.12 > SESOI, and _verdict() routes to GENERIC via dspec_not_pos = (upper CI ≤ SESOI_spec). But prereg §6's GENERIC row requires an EQUIVALENCE-null Δ_spec (CI ⊂ ±SESOI); the observed CI [−0.473,−0.229] is a large NEGATIVE effect, not an equivalence-null. A reader sees 'Δ_spec effect 0.34 ≫ SESOI, comfortably resolvable' (brief §pilot) and concludes example-specific content is anti-informative/harmful — when per Finding 1 the negativity is a norm-wastage signature, not content harm. The code's condition (upper CI ≤ SESOI) is strictly broader than the prereg text and silently admits significantly-negative Δ_spec into GENERIC with no requirement to explain the sign.
findings.fix: Reconcile code↔prereg at freeze. Either (a) restrict GENERIC to a genuine equivalence-null and add a distinct label for 'REAL significantly below MEAN (denoising-consistent)'; or (b) keep the broader not-positive condition but require the write-up to attribute negative Δ_spec to geometry (report τ(REAL)/τ(MEAN) vs E[cos]) and STOP describing |Δ_spec| as an effect size / 'effect-resolvable' — its magnitude is not the scientific estimand, so effect_resolvable=TRUE on Δ_spec certifies statistical resolvability of the wrong quantity.

findings.title: MEAN>SELF and the G1-D efficiency ratio are norm-confounded; SELF is not a norm-matched ceiling
findings.scenario: SELF is injected at the target's native ||s_i|| (s_norm_mean 0.554), while REAL/MEAN are at source ||s_j|| (0.678) — SELF and POS_SHAM are deliberately excluded from M5 norm-matching. So MEAN (0.979) > SELF (0.882) is partly just a larger injection norm, not necessarily pathology and not clean denoising corroboration; likewise τ(REAL)/τ(SELF) (G1-D efficiency) mixes a norm gap with content. A skeptic reads MEAN>SELF either as 'ceiling violated, pipeline broken' or as 'confirms denoising' — both over-read a comparison that is not norm-matched.
findings.fix: Report SELF's ||s|| beside REAL/MEAN and label SELF explicitly as the un-norm-matched M3 validity anchor (its job is reproducing C26's 0.875, which it does: 0.882), NOT a norm-comparable ceiling. If a ceiling comparison is desired, add a descriptive norm-matched SELF (s_i rescaled to ||s_j||). Do not interpret MEAN>SELF as evidence in either direction as currently drawn.

lenses.key_judgment: The pilot's Δ_spec = −0.34 (MEAN transfers MORE than REAL) is substantially a DENOISING ARTIFACT, not evidence that example-specific content is uninformative: norm-matching a single high-variance source vector against its own low-variance population mean forces REAL to waste its off-axis (sin²) energy on a locally-1D readout, and τ(REAL)/τ(MEAN)=0.66 matches E[cos(s_j,s̄)]≈0.5 almost exactly — the geometric prediction of pure wastage. The energy-spectrum diagnostic (54% off-axis) correctly REFUTES the opposite 'collinear-by-construction' artifact, proving a large example-specific component EXISTS, but that only sharpens the gap: the design cannot tell whether that off-axis component is uninformative noise or informative content the donor-margin readout is blind to at α=1 — which is exactly what INTENT asks. The GENERIC_READOUT_AXIS scope wording ('NOT ESTABLISHED', not 'absent') is the correct non-overclaim, but the primary is under-identified as it stands. The parallel/perpendicular decomposition (inject s_j⊥ alone at native norm, low-α, own OOD gate) is the cheap, head-only arm that cleanly settles it and should be REQUIRED before freeze, not treated as nice-to-have. SELF is a fair M3 anchor but a norm-confounded ceiling (0.554 vs 0.678), so MEAN>SELF indicates nothing pathological and nothing conclusive.

lenses.lens: Statistics / power — inference on the ratio-of-means transduction estimand τ = E[Δm]/E[coup], its two-way dyadic bootstrap, the MDE gate, the equivalence family, multiplicity, and R22 sampling stability.

findings.title: R22 seeded draws never subsample the source set — stability certification is vacuous
findings.scenario: Confirmatory at defaults: for d in range(5): src = src_all[permutation(300)[:300]] returns the same 300 objects reordered, because n_src=300 == |src_all|=300. So top_k_subspace(S['diff']) (U_D) and s_bar are byte-identical every draw; only match_pairs assignment jitter varies. across_draw Delta_spec_sd collapses toward 0, stability_ok = (sd <= 0.5*SESOI_spec = 0.025) passes trivially, and the team reports 'stable across >=5 seeded draws' having never varied the source derivation sample — reproducing the exact blind spot (held-out != sampling stability) that overturned A9/C30 under R22. Also 5 draws gives a 4-df SD whose 95% upper bound is ~1.9x the observed value.
findings.fix: Set n_src strictly below |src_all| (e.g. 200) or resample sources with replacement per draw so each derives an independent U_D/s_bar; raise the draw count for a real stability estimate.

findings.title: SRC_SHAM equivalence-null unreachable at this precision; contrast-only relabel swaps the frozen test
findings.scenario: SRC_SHAM absolute tau HW=0.176 exceeds SESOI_TAU=0.10, so it cannot pass the preregistered TOST equivalence family (S6-ii, CI subset of +/-0.10). If H_conf returns a POSITIVE Delta_spec (TRANSDUCING_STATE branch), the prereg S6 table explicitly requires 'SRC-SHAM sub-SESOI' as a licensing condition; at ~551 target/300 source genes that HW cannot shrink inside +/-0.10, so the positive headline would be unlicensed by the study's own rule. The readout-push exclusion (SRC_SHAM/REAL upper CI 0.177/0.64 ~= 0.28 < 0.5) does survive, so the load-bearing use is fine, but the equivalence-family membership is vacuous. Compounding: no-decoy sources fall back to a zero injection vector (diff_sham = Hcl-Hcl = 0), biasing SRC_SHAM toward 0 and widening its CI, so its near-zero point estimate is partly manufactured.
findings.fix: Repower SRC_SHAM (more sources) if a positive verdict is in play, or restrict SRC_SHAM in writing to the surviving sham-frac ratio-exclusion and drop its equivalence-family claim; report the fraction of zero-fallback sham pairs.

findings.title: Heavy-tail denominator leverage plus retention of near-zero bootstrap denominators
findings.scenario: The sum/sum ratio form is the correct robust choice (mean-of-ratios would explode at median coup 0.05) and pooled E[coup]=0.41 is safely far from 0, so the pooled primary is stable. But dyadic_ratio_ci discards a replicate only when |d|<1e-9, retaining tiny positive denominators. In a per-context subset (e.g. complex_event) whose E[coup] sits just above the M7=0.20 floor but is carried by a few high-coup genes, a Poisson draw zeroing those genes (P(w=0)=0.37 each; a pair survives only if both its target- and source-gene weights are nonzero, ~40% survival) shrinks the weighted denominator toward 0; surviving small-d replicates inject extreme ratios into the 2.5/97.5 percentiles, miscalibrating that context's tau CI. The two-way product-Poisson weight is also variance-inflating (conservative). Pooled primary is unaffected.
findings.fix: Report per-context bootstrap denominator health (fraction of replicates with d below ~0.25x observed d), trim/winsorize or use a studentized/BCa interval for per-context tau, and check coup has no aggregate sign-crossing under resampling.

findings.title: Effect-resolvability gate is legitimate, but SESOI_spec was never sealed and is scale-conflated
findings.scenario: Using |est_Hdev| in reaches_verdict = (proj_HW < SESOI) OR (|est_Hdev| - proj_HW > SESOI) is NOT a freeze violation: H_dev is the development split, the gate only decides interpret/don't-interpret, direction is not chosen (abs value), and the H_conf CI governs the actual verdict, so an optimistic gate at worst wastes compute on a contrast that returns INCONCLUSIVE. The real gap: SESOI_spec=0.05 is the code default, but prereg S11-#3 requires it sealed from the H_dev pilot and reconciled with the 0.05 ABSOLUTE-nat house floor (explicitly 'not the same scale'). Boundary case: if the defensible normalized SESOI were 0.10 (matching SESOI_TAU), a future Delta_spec near -0.08 flips between GENERIC_READOUT_AXIS and INCONCLUSIVE on an unsealed, scale-conflated threshold. Current effect (-0.34, 6x SESOI) does not bite.
findings.fix: Seal and justify SESOI_spec on H_dev before freeze and document its scale relation to the absolute-nat floor.

findings.title: Primary protected; max-T family adjustment unimplemented, harmless now but risky for contexts
findings.scenario: The primary Delta_spec is a single pre-declared contrast (REAL vs MEAN fixed a priori) and is fully protected. The prereg S6 max-T family adjustment is not implemented — contrasts use unadjusted per-contrast 95% CIs — but this is harmless for the positive family because TRANSDUCING_STATE requires ALL of {Delta_spec, REAL-RANDOM, REAL-SCRAMBLE} to clear (an intersection/min rule that is self-FWER-controlling), and RANDOM's equivalence CI (HW 0.031) is far inside the band so the missing family-adjusted alpha (mildly anti-conservative for equivalence) is immaterial. The 6-context secondary family (G1-E) is preregistered as a max-T family but is entirely absent from the pilot/confirmatory code; reporting any per-context Delta_spec as a finding would be 6 unadjusted shots inflating the spurious-positive rate.
findings.fix: Implement the context max-T secondary family before reporting any per-context result, and keep contexts strictly non-gating for the pooled primary as the prereg states.

lenses.key_judgment: Inference on the pooled primary is sound: the sum/sum ratio-of-means is the correct robust form for this heavy-tailed denominator (median coup 0.05), pooled E[coup]=0.41 keeps the denominator safely away from 0, the two-way product-Poisson dyadic bootstrap is a valid (if conservative) two-way clustering estimator, the effect-resolvability MDE gate is a legitimate dev-split feasibility filter and not a freeze violation, and the primary Delta_spec is protected from multiplicity. The provisional GENERIC_READOUT_AXIS verdict rests on a -0.34 effect (6x SESOI) driven by the structural MEAN-denoising asymmetry, so it is robust and interpretable. Two MAJOR fixes are required before the confirmatory can claim what it intends: (1) the R22 sampling-stability draws are non-functional as parameterized — n_src=300==|src_all| means the source subspace is identical across all draws, so the certification is vacuous and must be fixed by genuinely subsampling/resampling sources per draw; (2) SRC_SHAM cannot meet its preregistered equivalence-family bar at this precision, so a positive verdict would be unlicensed unless SRC_SHAM is repowered or its role is narrowed to the surviving sham-frac ratio exclusion. Neither is identifiability-fatal; both are mechanical, and the large structurally-driven primary effect is expected to survive them.

findings.title: GENERIC/NO_TRANSDUCTION verdict over-reaches: it bounds C16/C26 (delivered final-residual state) only, not C17/C18/C23 (addressing/routing)
findings.scenario: Confirmatory returns GENERIC_READOUT_AXIS. The decision table (prereg S6 NO_TRANSDUCTION row) and the CLAIMS wording to be sealed pre-run (S11-#10) say 'C16-C18/C23's interventional reach is bounded to intra-example patching.' But G1 injects ONLY the final donor residual (the C16/A5/C26 U_info object) additively and reads margin_hard(cls(.)). It never intervenes on L3H1's attention address (C23 = address+payload JOINT), L3H1->U_info routing (C17), or the transporter heads (C18). Under the project's own frozen ADDRESS/PAYLOAD split, a generic DELIVERED CONTENT is fully compatible with a completely example-specific ADDRESS (indeed C34/C35 say the address routes example-specifically through L3H1 attention). So bounding C23/C17/C18 on the strength of a final-residual content injection is unlicensed and contradicts the frozen mechanism. A skeptic kills the CLAIMS entry by pointing out the estimand touches neither the address nor the transporter selection.
findings.fix: Scope every bound to the C16/C26 delivered-state object (the final donor residual). Explicitly exempt C17 (routing), C18 (transporters), and C23 (address+payload joint) from the bound; state that final-residual injection does not test addressing. Fix the S6 table and S11-#10 wording before freeze.
findings.short_summary: Null verdict bounds C17/C18/C23, but estimand only tests C16/C26

findings.title: U_D-fit-by-context confound: pooled SELF=0.88 can mask poor short-source U_D fit in long-intron/non-canonical contexts, turning an instrument limitation into a false GENERIC call
findings.scenario: U_D and s_j are derived ONLY from single-pair short introns (dist 60-150). Targets span all contexts incl. cassette/complex/long-distance. The primary Delta_spec is paired-within-target so target covariates cancel, and pooled SELF=0.88 (~C26 0.875) shows U_D transfers on average -- this controls the confound POOLED. But G1-E reports Delta_spec per context (secondary max-T family). In a long-intron context where the short-source U_D poorly represents the delivered state, SELF-by-context could be ~0.3 while pooled SELF stays 0.88; there Delta_spec~0 is reported as GENERIC when it actually means 'U_D cannot represent this context's delivered state.' Per-context M7 (E[coup]>=0.20) does NOT catch this -- coupling magnitude can be healthy while U_D subspace fit is poor. The cross-CONTEXT half of the METHODOLOGY:220-223 requirement is then answered by an instrument artifact.
findings.fix: Report SELF (and the s_j energy captured by U_D) per Atlas context alongside Delta_spec before any per-context GENERIC interpretation; gate per-context interpretation on adequate SELF/U_D fit, not only on M7 coupling. Pooled verdict is unaffected.
findings.short_summary: Per-context GENERIC confounded with short-source U_D misfit

findings.title: R24 risk: the effectively-null Delta_spec (GENERIC) must be scoped to final-residual additive injection, not read as a global 'no example-specific content'
findings.scenario: R24 corrected P3.3's value-null: a null WITHIN a specific intervention was wrongly generalizable to 'the carrier does not build the payload.' Same trap here: Delta_spec<=0 is a null of example-specific transfer for (a) final-residual, (b) additive, (c) through the short-source rank-8 U_D. If the GENERIC verdict is later quoted in MECHANISM.md as 'the donor-side delivered state is a gene-generic readout axis, not example-specific' without those qualifiers, that is an R24-class over-generalization of a within-intervention null. Prereg S10 scopes the POSITIVE result ('localizes nothing beyond the final donor residual') but the decision table does not symmetrically scope the NULL.
findings.fix: Add the same locus/method qualifier to the GENERIC and NO_TRANSDUCTION rows of the S6 table and the CLAIMS wording; state the null is specific to final-residual additive injection through the short-source U_D and does not bound earlier-layer or non-additive example-specificity.
findings.short_summary: Scope the Delta_spec null to final-residual injection (R24)

findings.title: eligible() bypass / no min_effect admits ~65% low-coupling targets, entangling the GENERIC verdict with the MEAN-denoising crux
findings.scenario: Dropping eligible() drops the GAP filter on targets (correct -- context variety is the point) but also min_effect conditioning: coup_stats show frac(coup>=0.20)=0.35, i.e. ~65% of targets have coup<0.20, many near-inert. In inert targets there is little example-specific delivered structure, so REAL and MEAN both reduce to a generic push and the low-variance population-average MEAN mechanically outperforms the high-variance single-source REAL -- pushing Delta_spec negative for reasons entangled with the denoising fairness crux (brief attack #1). Ratio-of-means keeps tau well-defined, and the negative sign is not produced by inert-target dilution alone, but the GENERIC verdict cannot be cleanly attributed without isolating this. (The 1 admitted GC-AG donor is negligible; margin_hard is against a fixed bid across the cohort.)
findings.fix: Add a min_effect-qualified sensitivity Delta_spec (targets with coup>=0.20) as a pre-declared robustness arm; confirm the GENERIC verdict survives on behaviourally-competent targets.
findings.short_summary: No min_effect: inert targets entangle GENERIC with denoising

lenses.key_judgment: The measured quantity answers the INTENT and is a legitimate, in fact stricter, form of the METHODOLOGY:220-223 / MECHANISM S2 cross-example+cross-context transduction requirement (it adds the MEAN gene-generic-axis null the ROADMAP-literal lacked, correctly anticipating C26's 0.970 overlap). (a) Deriving U_D/s_j from short single-pair sources is the RIGHT 'never contributed' generality test, not a fatal confound: Delta_spec is within-U_D so U_D's origin cancels, and SELF=0.88 (~C26 0.875) empirically rules out gross U_D-target misspecification POOLED -- but per-context it does not (Finding 2). (b) Bypassing eligible() on targets is required by the intent (context variety); the residual threat is no-min_effect admitting ~65% low-coupling targets (Finding 4, MINOR, ratio-of-means mitigates). (c) R22 compliance is STRONG: no payload semantic identity is named (verdicts are TRANSDUCING/GENERIC/NO_TRANSDUCTION, geometric not semantic), and the R22 methodological lesson is honored -- >=5 seeded source-pool draws with a stability trigger plus a two-way source-gene x target-gene dyadic bootstrap. R23 compliance is CLEAN: injection is a single additive push at the final donor residual, there is no L3H1 attention x value DiD / Delta_bind, and POS_SHAM=0 is labeled FORCED and excluded from the AND gate. The GENERIC_READOUT_AXIS verdict does NOT contradict C26 -- it is the interventional corollary of C26's 0.970 direction overlap and reproduces C26's 0.875 via SELF (M3). The one real estimand<->claim mismatch is scope-precision: the null is licensed to bound only the C16/C26 delivered final-residual state, not C17/C18/C23 addressing/routing (Finding 1), and the null must carry a final-residual-injection qualifier to avoid an R24-style over-generalization (Finding 3). All four are wording/reporting fixes; none block the run, and the pilot already shows a resolvable, interpretable Delta_spec.

lenses.lens: Lens 4 — Calibration, plumbing, and Atlas→CouplingExample adapter

findings.title: M8 OOD band — the prereg's 'only failable health check' — is not implemented
findings.scenario: Prereg §3 M8 requires ||H_i(α)||/||H_cl,i|| and donor-logit entropy inside a frozen band 'in every interpreted arm×dose', and calls it 'the only health check that CAN fail here.' Nothing in run_g1 computes it — smoke, pilot, and confirm report only s_norm; there is no ratio against ||H_cl|| and no entropy band. The dose grid runs to α=1.5, so a target where 1.5·s pushes the residual off-manifold (margin_hard already saturates, P3.3) is scored and interpreted with no guard. T['Hcl'] is captured, so the data for M8 exists and is simply unused.
findings.fix: Implement M8: compute ||H_co,i+α·s||/||H_cl,i|| and donor-logit entropy per interpreted arm×dose, seal the band on H_dev, and gate/flag doses that breach it. Until then the α=1.5 (and arguably α=1.0) rows are uncontrolled for OOD.

findings.title: M4 (no-leakage) is hardcoded True — a memorial that cannot fail (R21 class)
findings.scenario: Prereg §3 M4 says leakage is 'asserted by gene-set hash.' In code the smoke memorial dict literally sets "M4_no_leakage": True with no computation. Disjointness is real (D_src=discovery split, targets=validation split, plus match_pairs enforces src gene != tgt gene), but the MEMORIAL verifies nothing: if a future edit pointed src_all at the validation split, or the discovery/validation hash split changed, M4 would still report True and the run would proceed to manufacture G1-B from leaked rows. This is exactly the un-failable-guard failure the project flagged in R21/R7.
findings.fix: Compute M4 from the actual gene sets: assert set(src gene_ids) ∩ set(H_dev∪H_conf gene_ids) == ∅ and hash both sets into provenance; fail the run otherwise.

findings.title: M3 (the strongest memorial) is gated at a toothless self_suff>0.3, tolerance never sealed
findings.scenario: Prereg §3/§9 call M3 'the strongest memorial here' — SELF must reproduce C26's held-out +0.875 'within a frozen tolerance (to be sealed)', and §9 makes 'M3 misses 0.875 beyond tolerance' a stopping condition. In code the only enforced check is mem_ok requiring self_suff>0.3, and the confirmatory _verdict never checks SELF at all. A pipeline that is subtly wrong but still yields SELF≈0.5 would pass the 0.3 floor and reach a verdict. The pilot SELF τ=0.88 does reproduce C26, but nothing gates on it, so the reproduction is decorative rather than load-bearing.
findings.fix: Seal the M3 tolerance (e.g. |SELF − 0.875| < 0.05) on D_src/H_dev and gate both the smoke AND the confirmatory verdict on it, per §9.

findings.title: Permuted-label FPR is calibrated only on degenerate self-pairs (gt==gs), not the two-way cross-gene decision it must certify
findings.scenario: The FPR check runs on pairs=[(i,i)] over D_src, so target-gene==source-gene for every pair and the two-way dyadic bootstrap collapses to a one-way (w[g]²) resampling. The confirmatory Δ_spec runs on match_pairs with gene-DISJOINT gt≠gs (genuine two-way structure). The sign-flip=label-swap logic and the conservative lo>0 vs decision-threshold lo>SESOI_spec are both correct, and FPR=0.02 passes — but the specificity gate never exercises the pairing structure of the interpreted estimand, so a two-way-specific miscalibration would be invisible.
findings.fix: Additionally run the permuted-label FPR once on the actual cross-example match_pairs structure (H_dev sources/targets) before freeze, or state explicitly that the two-way FPR is inherited-from-B3 and untested here.

findings.title: SRC_SHAM decoy-fallback silently injects zero, biasing the readout-push stopping check toward null; sham_ok never aggregated
findings.scenario: When _find_decoy_acceptor returns None, capture() appends the UNMODIFIED sequence, so Hsham==Hcl exactly, diff_sham==0, and arm_state('SRC_SHAM') = _rescale(0-vector, nj) returns the zero vector (norm<1e-12 guard), injecting num=0 for that pair. SRC_SHAM sits in the §6 equivalence family and the §9 'READOUT PUSH' stopping rule; contaminating it with exact-zero pairs biases it toward equivalence (anti-conservative — a real readout-push in SRC_SHAM would be diluted). sham_ok is recorded in meta but never counted, asserted, or reported, so the contamination rate is unknown. (Incidence is likely ~0: ~64–250 AGs per window and single-pair sources make a missing/functional decoy unlikely — but it is unmeasured.)
findings.fix: Aggregate and report frac(sham_ok); assert it ≈1.0 as a memorial; and exclude (not zero-fill) fallback pairs from the SRC_SHAM arm so the null is not diluted.

findings.title: M6/M7/M9 not mechanized as gates; M9 also hardcoded True; POS_SHAM≠0 stopping condition is dead code
findings.scenario: M9_determinism is a literal True like M4 (cannot fail). M6 (RANDOM τ≤0.05) and per-context M7 (E[coup]≥0.20, CI excludes 0) are §9 stopping conditions but are not coded as asserts in _run_all_contrasts/_verdict — the pilot happens to satisfy them (RANDOM 0.047, coup 0.41) but a confirmatory breach would not halt the run. §9 lists 'POS-SHAM≠0 ⇒ plumbing defect' as a stop, yet POS_SHAM num is hardcoded zeros, so that condition can never trigger (its guard role is redundant with M1/M2).
findings.fix: Mechanize M6/M7 (per-context) as hard gates; compute M9 from a cross-seed cohort-identity hash; delete or re-label the dead POS-SHAM stopping condition.

findings.title: Calibration never exercises the verdict threshold logic; planted slope gate relaxed from prereg
findings.scenario: The planted-positive uses ratio_of_means only (channel = margins_fn, correct), and the permuted-FPR uses dyadic_ratio_ci with a lo>0 check — but neither calibration ever calls _verdict(), so its SESOI_τ/SESOI_spec threshold comparisons, the dspec_pos/dspec_not_pos band logic, and the max-T family composition are uncalibrated. Separately, prereg §4 requires the planted slope CI to cover 1; the smoke gates only slope>0 (got 0.79). Saturation + U_D-projection make slope<1 expected, so the relaxation is defensible, but it is an undisclosed deviation from the frozen §4 criterion.
findings.fix: Add a planted-positive pass through the full _verdict() (a known-β source should return TRANSDUCING) to calibrate the decision layer; and either restore the §4 'slope CI covers 1' criterion or log a pre-run amendment justifying slope>0 by saturation.

findings.title: Adapter maps correctly, but eligible() bypass admits a GC donor and there is no min donor–partner distance guard for targets
findings.scenario: donor_win→donor_pos and acceptor_win→next_acceptor_pos are correct: pair() masks the donor at donor_pos and corrupts the partner AG at next_acceptor_pos-2 (the [awin-2,awin) dinucleotide); the 2<=awin guard keeps awin-2>=0; and M3/SELF reproducing C26 (0.88) confirms the mapping end-to-end (a misaligned donor_win would destroy the margin). Residual gaps: (i) eligible()'s GT filter is bypassed, admitting the 1 GC donor — harmless because the readout masks position dwin and reads logit(G), and GC donors also have G at dwin (1/1012, paired-normalized); (ii) unlike sources (single-pair, gap∈[60,150]), targets have no minimum donor–partner distance, so a target with awin≈dwin+3 would place the CC corruption one base from the masked donor, conflating the corruption with the donor motif.
findings.fix: No change required for the GC donor (document it). For targets, add a min donor–partner separation guard (e.g. next_acceptor_pos−donor_pos ≥ ~10) or report the realized distance distribution so near-donor corruptions can be excluded.

lenses.key_judgment: The B2-class fatal is ABSENT: the planted-positive travels the identical interpreted channel — both it (margins_fn(S['Hco']+β·s_src)) and the REAL arm (margins_fn(Hco[ti]+α·inj), inj=s_src[j]) route through the same margin_hard(cls(·)) additive final-residual add, with s*=β·project(diff_i,U_D) being exactly the object REAL injects. The permuted-label FPR correctly nulls REAL-vs-MEAN (sign-flip ≡ arm-label swap; lo>0 is conservative against the lo>SESOI_spec decision), FPR=0.02. POS_SHAM=0 is honestly LABELED FORCED (F2) and excluded from the verdict — architecturally forced because the final-residual, position-wise cls readout cannot be moved by a non-donor injection, so asserting 0 (vs computing) loses nothing. The adapter mapping (donor_win→donor_pos, acceptor_win-2 partner corruption) is correct and independently validated by SELF reproducing C26's 0.875 at 0.88. What must be fixed before freeze are declawed/missing memorials, not the science path: M8 (the designated failable OOD check) is unimplemented, M4 and M9 are hardcoded True (un-failable, R21 class), and the strongest memorial M3 is gated only at a toothless self_suff>0.3 with its C26-reproduction tolerance never sealed. Secondary: the FPR is calibrated on degenerate self-pairs rather than the two-way cross-gene structure, and the SRC_SHAM no-decoy fallback zero-fills (biasing the readout-push stopping check toward null) with sham_ok never aggregated. None of these threaten the pilot's already-resolvable GENERIC_READOUT_AXIS read; with the memorials restored the confirmatory yields an interpretable result.
